title: Healing of Blind Bartimaeus
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The learner describes Mark 10:46-52 (leaving Jericho, Bartimaeus cries "Son of David, have mercy", shouts louder when rebuked, throws off his cloak, asks to see, is healed by faith, follows Jesus) and discusses lessons (persistence, faith, Jesus cares for the outcast, following Jesus after help).

floor.prerequisite: Knows the healing of the bleeding woman.
floor.question: What did Jesus tell the woman who touched his cloak?

representations: the road out of Jericho drawn
steps: He is healed and follows Jesus.
contexts: a learner facing a long illness
helping a person with a disability

board.do: Draw a road with a crowd and a man by the side.

board.say: What did he do when the crowd told him to be quiet?

board.do: Wait for the learner to say he shouted louder.

misconceptions.repair: Read Mark 10:46: leaving Jericho. Mark it on a map on the road to Jerusalem.
Read Mark 10:47: "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!" Son of David is a title for the Messiah.

misconceptions.ask: What did Bartimaeus do after he was healed?
misconceptions.repair: Read Mark 10:52: he followed Jesus along the road.

listen_for: Put on his cloak and walked slowly
misconceptions.ask: What did Bartimaeus do when Jesus called him (Mark 10:50)?
misconceptions.repair: Explain a beggar's cloak was his bed and begging mat; throwing it aside showed eager faith.

checks.question: Name a lesson from the healing of Bartimaeus.
checks.answer: Persist in faith (follow Jesus after help)
